column1: # OwnTV-AI fork seam manifest — the single registry of every patch site this fork
# sews into upstream code. One line per site, TAB-separated, exactly four fields:
# repo: app (path relative to the app module's src/main/java/tv/own/owntv/) or
#       core (path relative to the core checkout's src/main/java/tv/own/owntv/)
# The generic test (SeamManifestTest) asserts every marker exists in its file. An upstream
# merge that rewrites one of these files and drops a patch site fails the release gate with
# the manifest id — no new bespoke audit is written per bug; new patch sites are ADDED here.
